scope: isolated virtual lab, real MPS PPO, no installed app or hardware
method: One 5-iteration warmup, then off/on/on/off. Training-loop elapsed_seconds excludes startup, evaluation and export. Two samples per condition, not a statistical performance guarantee. The full test suite had finished before these four runs.
cleanup: All smoke-run output weights and temporary Electron/job profiles removed; existing user runs, base policy cache and installed app preserved.
